suggestions.label: Compare two options
suggestions.prompt: Help me compare two options. Ask me what they are, then build a short table with sources.

suggestions.label: Explain a paper
suggestions.prompt: I'll paste a paper link or abstract. Explain the idea simply, then its evidence and its limits.

taskTemplates.name: Weekly reading list
taskTemplates.prompt: Suggest five things worth reading this week on the topics in NOTES.md (create it with a short placeholder if missing). One line each: title, why it matters.
